[[T:TBMore]]

This article introduces the most interesting new features, improvements, and changes visible to users which are available in Thunderbird 128 Nebula.

__TOC__

=Cards View improvements=
* To be consistent with Table View, Cards View displays a green dot to indicate unread emails (prior versions did not display anything to indicate that the email was unread in Cards View).
*;[[Image:TB128-cardview-unread-greendot.png]]
* The '''starburst''' (for new messages since the last time this folder was opened) indicator for both Cards View and Table View is now a yellow diamond (previously, it was a circle for Cards View).
*;[[Image:TB128-cardview-newsince-folder-opened-starburst.png]]

=Accent Color=
Thunderbird now offers improved theme compatibility, which is especially beneficial for our Linux users on Ubuntu and Mint. 

For example, in Ubuntu if you change Ubuntu {menu Settings} > {menu Appearance} > '''Color''' to '''purple''', you will see selected emails outlined in purple as seen in the following screenshot of Cards View:
;[[Image:TB128-purple-accent-color-ubuntu2204-cardview]]

=Mailing List improvements=
You can now unsubscribe to mailing lists, open list archives (on the web) etc. for mailing lists that support standard headers such as '''List-Unsubscribe''' and '''List-Archive''', etc.
